events.description: Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
Goal! Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top right corner. It's 1:1.
Goal - 2:1! Joshua Kimmich tees up Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Fabian Bredlow.
An own goal! Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) had a great deal of bad luck. He wanted to intercept a dangerous pass, but he hit it in badly and sent it past his goalkeeper.
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nathaniel Brown departs the field of play to be replaced by Ismael Saibari (Bayern Munich).
Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
Here is a change. Tiago Tomas is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart).
Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Dzenan Pejcinovic and he is replaced by Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart).
Soren Storks shows a yellow card to Finn Jeltsch (VfB Stuttgart) for his blatant foul.
The substitution has been made. Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) has replaced Alphonso Davies.
Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Deniz Undav will be replaced by Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart).
Jeff Chabot goes off the pitch and Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
The game is interrupted. Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
Goal! Ismael Saibari puts the ball on a plate for Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 4:1.
Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) replaces Harry Kane.
Substitution. Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) has come on for Min-Jae Kim.
The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch so that Aleksandar Pavlovic can be given a rest.
Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Angelo Stiller is replaced by Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart).
Goal! The ball breaks to Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 5:1.
A yellow card for bad language! Grischa Promel (VfB Stuttgart) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
Goal! Francis Onyeka passes the ball to Lukas Petkov (Elversberg) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Mark Flekken couldn't do anything about it. 1:0.
Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Cole Campbell (Elversberg) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 2:0.
Maximilian Rohr (Elversberg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Hartmann had an easy-decision to make.
Robert Hartmann shows a yellow card to Cole Campbell (Elversberg) for his blatant foul.

Lukas Petkov sends a precise lofted cross into the box. David Mokwa Ntusu (Elversberg) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 3:0.
This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) was quite harsh and Robert Hartmann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
Today's match ends for Loic Bade who will be replaced by Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen).
Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Ezequiel Fernandez is replaced by Facundo Medina (Bayer Leverkusen).
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucas Vazquez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen).
Here is a change. Cole Campbell is going off and Vincent Wagner gives the last tactical orders to Maurice Krattenmacher (Elversberg).
It is time for a substitution. Noah Darvich (Elversberg) is on for Francis Onyeka.
It will be a substitution. Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is ready to enter the pitch as Malik Tillman walks off.
Luca Schnellbacher (Elversberg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing David Mokwa Ntusu.
Vincent Wagner has decided to make a change. Luca Sirch (Elversberg) replaces Jan Gyamerah.
Fantastic team goal! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) was set free in the area by Ibrahim Maza and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 3:1.
Facundo Medina (Bayer Leverkusen) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
The substitution is prepared. Florian Le Joncour (Elversberg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Maximilian Rohr.
Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Afonso Moreira and he is replaced by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen).
This is a yellow card! Nicolas Kristof (Elversberg) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
Goal! Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 3:2.

A perfectly taken corner kick. Emmanuel Latte Lath (Union Berlin) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the top right corner, increasing the score of today's match – 1:0.
Goal! Younes Ebnoutalib (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Younes Ebnoutalib (Eintracht Frankfurt), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 1:2.
Younes Ebnoutalib (Eintracht Frankfurt) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
Jeremiaha Maluze (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Michel Aebischer (Union Berlin) was quite harsh and Bastian Dankert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
It is time for a substitution. Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) is on for Michel Aebischer.
Mauro Lustrinelli has decided to substitute Andras Schafer and he is replaced by Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin).
Here's the change. Emmanuel Latte Lath leaves the pitch and Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) comes on as a substitute.
Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Malik Pimpong (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Jonathan Burkardt.

The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Younes Ebnoutalib (Eintracht Frankfurt) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the left post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Matheo Raab, so the score changes to 1:3.
Here is a change. Aljoscha Kemlein is going off and Mauro Lustrinelli gives the last tactical orders to Janik Haberer (Union Berlin).

A perfectly taken corner kick. Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes inside the left post, increasing the score of today's match – 2:3.

Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ayoube Amaimouni.
Zeno Van Den Bosch (Union Berlin) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastian Dankert had an easy-decision to make.
Here comes a substitution. Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) is brought on as a substitute for Marin Ljubicic.
Bastian Dankert shows a yellow card to Raphael Onyedika (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his blatant foul.
Adi Hutter prepares a substitution. Younes Ebnoutalib is replaced by Otavio (Eintracht Frankfurt).
That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Otavio (Eintracht Frankfurt).
It's a goal! Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) puts the ball past the goalkeeper!
Goal! Great play by Tidiam Gomis releases Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom left corner. 1:0.
Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top right corner in trademark fashion.
Wael Mohya goes off the pitch and David Herold (B. Monchengladbach) comes on.
Substitution. Robin Hack makes his way off the pitch and Isac Lidberg (B. Monchengladbach) comes on as his replacement.
Eugen Polanski decides to make a substitution. Kevin Stoger will be replaced by Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach).
Here's the change. Lukas Ullrich leaves the pitch and Mathieu Nguefack (B. Monchengladbach) comes on as a substitute.
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christopher Nkunku (RB Leipzig) comes onto the pitch for Tidiam Gomis.
Goal! Christopher Nkunku plays a pass to the feet of Rocco Reitz (RB Leipzig) and he shoots low into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 3:0.
A yellow card for a tackle by Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig). Sven Jablonski doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) will replace Brajan Gruda.
Martin Demichelis has decided to make a change. Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) replaces Ridle Baku.
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig) replaces Rocco Reitz.
Here is a change. Ezechiel Banzuzi is going off and Martin Demichelis gives the last tactical orders to Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig).
Adam Daghim (Hoffenheim) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.

Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Oliver Baumann is just a bystander as the ball flies into the right side of the goal. The score is 1:1.
That's the end of the game for Bernardo, who is replaced by Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim).
Christian Ilzer has decided to make a change. Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) replaces Adam Hlozek.

Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the right post, but Marvin Schwabe leaps out to thwart his attempt. The ball goes out of play. Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
Said El Mala goes off the pitch and Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) comes on.
Rene Wagner has decided to substitute Paul Okon-Engstler and he is replaced by Ellyes Skhiri (1. FC Koln).
It is time for a substitution. Thijs Dallinga (1. FC Koln) is on for Ragnar Ache.

Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner kick and scores with a great header into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:2.
A substitution has been made. Patrick Wimmer is replaced by Nathan De Cat (Hoffenheim).
Thijs Dallinga (1. FC Koln) gets on the scoresheet! He latched on to a precise pass and coolly slotted the ball into the top left corner.
Goal! Thijs Dallinga (1. FC Koln) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:2.
The foul by Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Florian Badstubner.
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Daghim departs the field of play to be replaced by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim).
Christian Ilzer decides to make a substitution. Albian Hajdari will be replaced by Mats Rots (Hoffenheim).

Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) picked up a yellow card from referee.

Here comes a substitution. Sheraldo Becker is given a rest as he is replaced by Otto Ruoppi (Mainz).
The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ransford Konigsdorffer (Mainz) will replace Jae-Sung Lee.
Mattes Hansen (Paderborn) picks up a yellow card.
Urs Fischer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Silvan Widmer (Mainz) replacing Anthony Caci.
Substitution. Jonah Sticker (Paderborn) replaces Mattes Hansen.
Substitution. Laurin Ulrich will be replaced by Tom Baack (Paderborn).

Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
It will be a substitution. Clemens Lippmann (Paderborn) is ready to enter the pitch as Marvin Pieringer walks off.
Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
A yellow card for a tackle by Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger). Felix Zwayer doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
Giannis Konstantelias (Dortmund) is being substituted because of an injury. Niko Kovac sends Marcel Sabitzer on the pitch.
Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Felix Zwayer ignores the protests.
Here comes a substitution. Patson Daka is given a rest as he is replaced by Terem Moffi (Hamburger).
It's time for a substitution. Kofi Amoako (Hamburger) comes on in place of Martin Adeline.
The manager has decided to make a substitution and Felix Nmecha walks off the pitch to be replaced by Joey Veerman (Dortmund).
Niko Kovac prepares a substitution. Konstantinos Karetsas is replaced by Samuele Inacio (Dortmund).
Filippo Mane (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Julian Ryerson.
Samuele Inacio (Dortmund) knows very well what he has done, despite his innocent look, and the referee sends him off the pitch with a straight red!
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jordan Torunarigha departs the field of play to be replaced by Bilal Nadir (Hamburger).
Merlin Polzin has decided to make a change. Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) replaces Bakery Jatta.
Substitution. Maximilian Beier will be replaced by Kaua Prates (Dortmund).
Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) is booked.
Substitution. Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) on for Louis Lemke.

Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Jan-Niklas Beste. His header was precise and ended up inside the left post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:0.
Goal! Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot inside the left post.
Julian Schuster makes a switch. Cyriaque Irie is coming on in place of Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) at the start of the second period.
Half-time substitution. Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is replaced by Dariusz Stalmach.
Goal! Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 3:0.
Daniel Siebert shows the yellow card to Ludovit Reis (Werder Bremen) for a heavy challenge.
It's 4:0! Igor Matanovic feeds Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
Substitution. Salim Musah (Werder Bremen) in, Justin Njinmah out.
Daniel Thioune decides to make a substitution. Niclas Fullkrug will be replaced by Cedric Itten (Werder Bremen).
The referee signals a substitution. Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) is brought on as a substitute for Philipp Lienhart.
Julian Schuster has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Philipp Treu (Freiburg) replacing Lukas Kubler.
The manager makes a subsitution with Lucas Holer (Freiburg) coming on for Igor Matanovic.

It's in the back of the net! Dariusz Stalmach (Werder Bremen) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header into the middle of the net. 4:1.
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yuito Suzuki leaves the pitch and Keisuke Goto (Freiburg) comes on.
Here is a change. Ludovit Reis is going off and Daniel Thioune gives the last tactical orders to Eren Dinkci (Werder Bremen).
The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen) comes onto the pitch so that Marco Grull can be given a rest.
Keisuke Goto (Freiburg) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
Sascha Stegemann shows a yellow card to Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) for his blatant foul.
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maximilian Wober (Schalke) replaces Hasan Kurucay.
Miron Muslic has decided to make a change. Junior Dina Ebimbe (Schalke) replaces Junior Adamu.
Substitution. Vitalie Becker leaves the pitch and is replaced by Robin Gosens (Schalke).
Ron Schallenberg (Schalke) is red-carded. He has to leave the pitch.
Manuel Baum decides to make a substitution. Robin Fellhauer will be replaced by Mert Komur (Augsburg).
Substitution. Edin Dzeko (Schalke) on for Nikola Katic.

Goal! Anton Kade (Augsburg) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Loris Karius had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.
Here's the change. Fabian Rieder leaves the pitch and Yannik Keitel (Augsburg) comes on as a substitute.
Manuel Baum has decided to substitute Michael Gregoritsch and he is replaced by Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg).
Today's match ends for Adil Aouchiche who will be replaced by Mertcan Ayhan (Schalke).
Substitution. Calvin Brackelmann makes his way off the pitch and Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) comes on as his replacement.
Manuel Baum prepares a substitution. Marius Wolf is replaced by Young-Woo Seol (Augsburg).
Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.

An amazing individual effort from Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 1:0. Marvin Schwabe was helpless.
Jahmai Simpson-Pusey (1. FC Koln) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Christian Dingert had an easy-decision to make.
Rene Wagner makes a half-time substitution. Ellyes Skhiri comes on in place of Paul Okon-Engstler (1. FC Koln).
Rene Wagner makes a switch. Mikey Moore (1. FC Koln) is coming on in place of Jan Thielmann at the start of the second period.
Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) lunges into his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
Goal - 2:0! Maximilian Mittelstadt tees up Grischa Promel (VfB Stuttgart) inside the box and he slams the ball into the roof of the net and past Marvin Schwabe.
Substitution. Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) in, Chris Fuhrich out.
Here is a change. Deniz Undav is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart).
Substitution. Reigan Heskey (1. FC Koln) has come on for Linton Maina.
Rene Wagner has decided to make a change. Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) replaces Ragnar Ache.
Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Marvin Schwabe with a strike into the right side of the goal. He makes it 3:0.
Substitution. Bilal El Khannouss is replaced by Leo Sauer (VfB Stuttgart).
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Maximilian Mittelstadt.
Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) just scored an own goal! He was attempting to clear the pass into the six-yard box from the side, but instead turned the ball into his own goal. Unlucky.
What was Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) has tested the patience of referee Christian Dingert and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
Rene Wagner decides to make a substitution. Tom Krauss will be replaced by Imad Rondic (1. FC Koln).
What an absolute cracking goal! Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) hits a perfect volley from far out and the ball flies inside the right post. Take a bow.
Here comes a substitution. Angelo Stiller is given a rest as he is replaced by Yanik Spalt (VfB Stuttgart).
Filippo Mane just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Ethan Nwaneri (Dortmund) replaces him.
Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) breaks through the defence and scores a brilliant goal from outside the penalty area after firing the ball inside the left post!
Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
Niko Kovac has made a change at the break. Joey Veerman (Dortmund) has come on in place of Felix Nmecha.

Goal! Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Gregor Kobel had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.
It's 2:1! Waldemar Anton feeds Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the left side of the net.
A substitution has been made. Konstantinos Karetsas is replaced by Fabio Silva (Dortmund).
Niko Kovac prepares a substitution. Joane Gadou is replaced by Luca Reggiani (Dortmund).
Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) is penalised.
Goal! Serhou Guirassy displays great vision and sends a pass to Fabio Silva (Dortmund), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 2:2.
It is time for a substitution. Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is on for Adam Hlozek.
Christian Ilzer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bambase Conte (Hoffenheim) replacing Patrick Wimmer.
Luca Reggiani (Dortmund) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Maximilian Beier (Dortmund).
Substitution. Ozan Kabak did his best and is replaced by Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim).
Here is a change. Wouter Burger is going off and Christian Ilzer gives the last tactical orders to Nathan De Cat (Hoffenheim).

Tim Lemperle is being substituted because of an injury. Christian Ilzer sends Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) on the pitch.
OWN GOAL! Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 2:3.
Serhou Guirassy will be replaced by Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund).
Fantastic team goal! Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) was set free in the area by Miguel Gutierrez and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the left side of the net. 1:0.
Felix Uduokhai (Union Berlin) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robin Braun had an easy-decision to make.
Goal! Facundo Medina (Bayer Leverkusen) makes the score 2:0 after burying a close-range header into the roof of the net after a good run and cross by Miguel Gutierrez.
This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Zeno Van Den Bosch (Union Berlin) was quite harsh and Robin Braun didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

Superb finishing from Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen). Jarell Quansah plays a fantastic through ball and finds Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goal and fire a low shot from close range past the goalkeeper. It's 3:0.
Robin Braun shows a yellow card to Miguel Gutierrez (Bayer Leverkusen) for his blatant foul.
It will be a substitution. Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) is ready to enter the pitch as Emmanuel Latte Lath walks off.
Mauro Lustrinelli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) replacing Michel Aebischer.
Aljoscha Kemlein comes off the pitch to be replaced by Janik Haberer (Union Berlin).
Goal! Patrik Schick passes the ball to Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Frederik Ronnow couldn't do anything about it. 4:0.
Patrik Schick goes off the pitch and Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on.
Carles Martinez decides to make a substitution. Malik Tillman will be replaced by Moussa Diaby (Bayer Leverkusen).
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Robert Andrich replaces Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen).
Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Facundo Medina and he is replaced by Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen).
Mauro Lustrinelli prepares a substitution. Josip Juranovic is replaced by Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin).
Substitution. Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) in, Livan Burcu out.
Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Miguel Gutierrez.
Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
Goal! Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Laurin Curda (Paderborn) was quite harsh and Max Burda didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
Max Burda shows the yellow card to Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) for a heavy challenge.
The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Ralf Kettemann gives a chance to Steffen Tigges and Rayan Philippe (Paderborn) is off.
Jano ter Horst (Paderborn) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Max Burda didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) receives a yellow card for infringement.
Max Burda shows a yellow card to Yannik Engelhardt (Freiburg), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

Here comes a substitution. Stefano Marino (Paderborn) is brought on as a substitute for Marvin Pieringer.
Here comes a substitution. Mattes Hansen is given a rest as he is replaced by Niklas Mohr (Paderborn).
The main referee, Max Burda, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Tjark Scheller (Paderborn) is given a yellow card for dissent.
Eren Dinkci (Werder Bremen) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
Chuki (Werder Bremen) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cedric Itten (Werder Bremen) comes onto the pitch so that Niclas Fullkrug can be given a rest.
